subject: indiv-td
title: (R)INDIV.TD.------MT.INFO.
description: Chart on book p. 211 (CMOA(I)-5). INDIV-TD (individual tendencies) is the subject, with the (R) prefix, "the reality of"; MT-INFO (multi-information) is the partner. From the subject: PROG-CONT (progressional continuance) and INFO-AF-B (information affinity basis). From INFO-AF-B: VT-DY (vibrational dynamics) and SOC-RT (social reality). From VT-DY: EXP-DY (expansion dynamics). From SOC-RT: DYM-F (dynamic functionalism) and AFI2 (affinity insight—second degree). From EXP-DY: AFI1 (affinity insight—first degree). From AFI2: RT-ALGN (reality alignment).
